description: Use this when: the user looks for open 나라장터 construction bid notices by words (공고명·발주기관), licence (업종·면허), region (시·도 or 시·군), 추정가격 range or how soon they close. Returns open notices, nearest deadline first, each with its licence and region limits and the page link. Do not use this when: the user asks whether a given company can enter (use check_eligibility) or about one known notice number (use get_notice).
